items.text: Cardinals traded Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans (for picks); MHJ inactive for ARI game. ETR not expected. Bio change noted.
items.why: Schefter/Rap joint report on trade details; inactive confirmed.
items.implication: MHJ to HOU offense long-term; ARI WR room opens (Wilson/Bourne).
items.opportunity: Immediate ARI target share to Michael Wilson et al.; HOU depth add.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to OUT with groin (Rap earlier Q). ETR watching list.
items.why: In-game/ pre downgrade reports from Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts; handcuff/backup elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining HOU RBs.

items.text: Actives include Ashton Jeanty and Terry McLaurin. ETR had both as GTDs; confirmed playing. Flowers also active/expected.
items.why: Schefter actives list; Rap/ETR alignment on expected/play; Flowers SNF active confirmed.
items.implication: Jeanty and McLaurin startable with possible limits; Flowers WR2/3 viable.
items.opportunity: Monitor warmups for Jeanty workload; McLaurin limited snaps possible post-hammy.

items.text: ETR updated GTD Justin Jefferson to expected to play / active; Jordan Addison not expected and inactive. Schefter/Rap confirmed Jefferson active, Addison inactive vs Saints.
items.why: Weekend reports and final updates; corroborated by Schefter photo/actives and RapSheet.
items.implication: Jefferson remains WR1 start; Addison sit, potential target bump to other Vikes WRs if any.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes for Jefferson if cleared fully.

items.text: ETR final update: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play (from prior uncertainty/no info). Schefter confirmed both questionable but will play vs Dolphins.
items.why: Messiest week notes from Levitan/ETR; Schefter explicit will-play report.
items.implication: Both CIN WRs locked starts; full target competition resumes.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel out remainder of game with hamstring. Rap confirmed ruled out. ETR watching.
items.implication: SF WR targets redistribute rest of game/ROS risk if multi-week.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (earlier not expected). ETR not expected.
items.why: Schefter explicit limited snaps; foot injury.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; LAC WR targets to others like Johnston/Harris.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes for remaining Chargers WRs.

items.text: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) downgraded to OUT. Schefter confirmed. ETR watching list.
items.implication: MIN TE streamer needed; target bump elsewhere in passing game.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially inactive (ETR not expected). Chance to play next week per Rap.
items.implication: Bears backup QB; CHI pass-catchers downgraded short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; Swift/others run-game focus.

items.text: Rico Dowdle not expected/OUT (toe). Levitan notes coaches refuse workhorse on Warren pre-injury but now with Dowdle out, Warren passes every test, Austin Ekeler-esque.
items.why: ETR summary; Levitan player-specific praise post-usage.
items.implication: Warren clear workhorse RB2/1 upside while Dowdle sidelined.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target share for Warren; goal-line/third-down.

items.text: ETR weekend summary NOT EXPECTED: Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Darius slayton, Josh Palmer. Multiple GTDs resolved later.
items.why: Comprehensive ETR AM summary aligned with later Schefter/Rap facts.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups listed in other items.

items.text: In DFS cash review, Jahmyr Gibbs was best salary-adjusted value by big margin despite high salary; only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups. Must play.
items.why: Projections showed elite value; postgame ownership note; Lions offense strong.
items.implication: Strong start/sit and DFS cash core; low ownership leverage.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere. (Post-game heat as waiver add.)
items.why: Berry direct observation of waiver activity post performance.
items.implication: Priority waiver add in leagues; GB RB depth/handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Monitor for increased role if Jacobs limited or absent.

items.text: Messiest injury week remembered: no Bengals WR info initially, ton of GTDs, docks on playing-through-injury guys. Projections updated live.
items.why: Levitan direct comment quoting ETR summary; links projections.
items.implication: Heightened monitoring needed; late swaps critical for starts.
items.opportunity: Value in cleared players with docks vs full health assumptions.
